text_block_list.text:
Today's Derby features the generation
after
Мэйсё Дото's. The crowd favorite,
Air Shakur,
loses the crown by a mere
seven centimeters.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, this hardly upsets the racer in
question.
She had apparently
anticipated this result all
along.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The future is restrained by sets of
numbers. Thus,
Мэйсё Дото's future,
too, is bound by a certain
limit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Doto's clumsy nature introduces so
many
variables, so she might just be able
to confound
the calculations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
